# OilPrice.com

> Real-time crude oil prices, energy market data, and comprehensive coverage of fossil fuels, alternative energy, and geopolitical impacts on global energy markets.

OilPrice.com provides live pricing for WTI and Brent crude, futures contracts, and rig count data alongside daily news analysis. The platform covers traditional energy commodities (oil, natural gas, coal) and emerging renewable technologies (solar, wind, nuclear, hydroelectric).

## Key Topics

- WTI Crude Oil
- Brent Crude Oil
- Natural Gas
- OPEC
- Oil Prices
- Energy Markets
- Crude Oil Futures
- Price Tracking
- Renewable Energy
- Solar Energy
- Nuclear Power
- Geopolitics
- Commodity Prices
- Rig Count Data
- Energy News

## Live Pricing & Market Data

- [Crude Oil Prices Today | OilPrice.com](https://oilprice.com): Homepage with live crude oil prices, charts for WTI, Brent, and energy news
- [Oil Price Charts | Oilprice.com](https://oilprice.com/oil-price-charts): Real-time oil price charts and tracking for global crude oil markets
- [WTI Crude Oil Futures Contracts | Oilprice.com](https://oilprice.com/futures/wti): WTI crude oil futures contracts data and price forecasts for next 10 years
- [North American Rig Count, Drilling and Frac Spread Count Data](https://oilprice.com/rig-count): North American oil and gas rig count data with charts and drilling metrics
